page.title: PopolaLoom · A loom that weaves agents
hero.title: PopolaLoom
hero.lead: Local-first meta-orchestrator that sits on top of every agent CLI on your machine — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, GitHub Copilot — and gives them a single dispatch surface, a persistent task bus, and a unified HITL channel.
install.heading: Install in one line
features.heading: Why PopolaLoom?
feature.dispatch.title: Single dispatch surface
feature.dispatch.body: popola dispatch "..." --cli=cursor|claude|codex|kimi|copilot — one command shape across every agent CLI on your machine.
feature.survival.title: Cross-terminal task survival
feature.survival.body: popolad UDS daemon with persistent SQLite task pool; tasks outlive shell close, SSH disconnect, even reboots.
feature.handoff.title: Hands-off envelope (v0.8.0+)
feature.handoff.body: Every dispatch persists a Markdown front-matter envelope to .local/.agent/handoff/ — auditable, replayable via popola dispatch --replay <id>, addressable by content-derived slug-hash.
feature.hitl.title: HITL across 5 channels
feature.hitl.body: Lark / IDE / CLI / MCP / Web — first responder wins via atomic cross-channel sync. LangGraph interrupt() broadcasts to all five.
feature.skill.title: Skill-based auto-discovery
feature.skill.body: popola init writes SKILL.md into Cursor / Claude / Codex / Copilot; host agents auto-load it. install-popola Skill (v0.7.0+) walks fresh installs.
feature.eval.title: 8-dim PopolaLoom-nines self-eval
feature.eval.body: popola eval run produces a composite score with per-dimension evidence pipelines — dispatch_isolation, hitl_latency, attach_correctness, cross_cli_handoff, and four more.
design.heading: Design in one picture
design.sidecar.title: Sidecar, not another IDE
design.sidecar.body: The popolad daemon owns process lifetime, task state, and event logs while each agent CLI stays isolated in its own subprocess.
design.envelope.title: File-backed handoff
design.envelope.body: Long prompts become audited Markdown envelopes with slug-hash ids, avoiding argv limits and making replay deterministic.
design.hitl.title: Human-in-the-loop fanout
design.hitl.body: Interrupts fan out to Lark, IDE, CLI, MCP, and web surfaces; one atomic answer resumes the task and late replies back off.

status.heading: Project status
status.lead: v0.9.7 carries forward the v0.9.0 GA stability boundary while refreshing the public docs for cloud workers, secure key storage, and Cloud HITL gamma. Cursor Cloud dispatch, self-hosted worker handoff, multi-run attach, cross-PR relay, and file-backed handoff now share one documented surface. The safe install path is ./install.sh install, with ./install.sh install --with-credentials for OS-keyring-backed Cursor API keys.
notice.en_only: This page has no Chinese translation yet — header / footer / landing page only.
feature.cloud.title: Cloud + self-hosted worker (v0.8.5–v0.9.3)
feature.cloud.body: Dispatch to Cursor Cloud, stream cloud runs, or register this machine with popola cloud worker while keeping popola status / attach semantics consistent.
feature.credentials.title: Secure credential storage (v0.9.2+)
feature.credentials.body: popola auth cursor set --validate stores the Cursor API key in the OS keyring; v0.9.7 adds ./install.sh install --with-credentials for the optional backend.
design_ideas.heading: Core design ideas
design_ideas.loom: Loom, not router — N agent strands become one audited tapestry through dispatch, handoff files, and replay-by-id.
design_ideas.sidecar: Sidecar daemon — popolad owns process lifetime, SQLite state, event logs, cloud polling, and HITL so terminals can disappear safely.
design_ideas.boundary: Automation-grade boundary — v0.9.0+ locks CLI verbs, daemon RPC routes, --json schemas, and config section names while marking experiments explicitly.
